mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_notification (sent_by, title, body, target_type, target_id, fcm_token, status, error_msg) VALUES (#{sentBy}, #{title}, #{body}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{fcmToken}, #{status}, #{errorMsg})
mapper.select: SELECT id, sent_at, sent_by, title, body, target_type, target_id, fcm_token, status, error_msg FROM erp_notification ORDER BY sent_at DESC
SELECT id, sent_at, sent_by, title, body, target_type, target_id, fcm_token, status, error_msg FROM erp_notification WHERE target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY sent_at DESC
